SHIPPING_POLICY:
Where we ship

We ship to Belgium and the rest of the European Union. Other destinations are shown at checkout when available.

Cost

The shipping cost is shown at checkout before you pay.

Delivery times

Most products ship from partner warehouses within 1 to 3 working days. Delivery then takes 5 to 12 working days in the EU, depending on the product and destination. An order with several products can arrive in more than one parcel.

Tracking

You receive a tracking link by email as soon as each parcel leaves the warehouse.

Customs

Orders delivered inside the EU carry no customs fees. For destinations outside the EU, import duties and taxes may apply and are paid by the recipient.

Problems

If a parcel is late, lost or arrives damaged, write to contact@survivalbase.net with your order number and, for damage, a photo.
REFUND_POLICY:
14-day right of withdrawal

If you are a consumer in the EU you can withdraw from your purchase within 14 days from the day you receive the goods, without giving a reason. To do so, send us a clear statement by email to contact@survivalbase.net with your order number. You can use the EU model withdrawal form, but you do not have to.

Returning the goods

Send the goods back within 14 days of telling us. We give you the return address by email. Return shipping costs are paid by you, unless the product is faulty or not what you ordered. You are responsible for any loss in value caused by handling the goods beyond what is needed to check them.

Refund

We refund the price paid, including standard delivery costs, within 14 days of receiving your withdrawal, using the original payment method. We may wait until we have received the goods back or proof that you sent them.

Exceptions

Sealed hygiene and medical items (for example first aid consumables) cannot be returned once the seal is broken. Food and water treatment consumables cannot be returned once opened.

Legal guarantee

All products carry the 2-year EU legal guarantee of conformity. If a product is faulty, write to contact@survivalbase.net and we repair, replace or refund it.
PRIVACY_POLICY:
Controller: White Rabbit Integrated Communication, Square de Meeûs 35, 1000 Brussels, Belgium (contact@survivalbase.net).

What we collect

When you order: name, email, phone, delivery and billing address, order contents. Payments are processed by Shopify Payments and its partners; we never see full card numbers. On the website: technical data needed to run it and, with your consent, analytics and advertising cookies.

Why

To deliver your order and handle returns (contract), to meet accounting and tax obligations (legal obligation), and, only if you agree, to send you news and offers (consent, which you can withdraw at any time).

Who receives it

Shopify (shop platform), payment providers, our fulfilment partners and carriers, only as needed to deliver your order. Some of these process data outside the EU under EU standard contractual clauses.

How long

Order data is kept for 7 years for accounting purposes. Marketing data is kept until you unsubscribe.

Your rights

You can ask for access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability or object to processing by writing to contact@survivalbase.net. You can also complain to the Belgian Data Protection Authority (dataprotectionauthority.be).
